title: Petty cash
subtitleOwner: Cash kept in Kochi for small spends. The housekeeper records every spend with the bill details; you record each top-up.
subtitleHk: Write down every rupee you spend from the cash box, with the bill details. Record cash you receive too.
negativeOwner: More has been spent than you gave. Send a top-up and record it as cash received.
negativeHk: You have spent more than you received. Tell the owner so they can send a top-up.
emptyBodyOwner: Start by recording the cash you give your housekeeper with "Cash received".
emptyBodyHk: Tap "Record a spend" each time you buy something with the cash box money.
